name: Endometriosis and Adenomyosis: Chocolate Cysts, DIE and Stepped Care

reference.source: Sakshi Arora Obstetrics E9 + Gynecology by Ten Teachers 21st Edition (topic map; text rewritten, no verbatim copy)
reference.pathophysiology: Refluxed endometrium implants bleeding cyclically scarring pouches while junctional myometrium hyperplasises thickening; hypoestrogenic analogues starve implants thinning bone needing add-back, and cyst stripping removes cortex depleting follicles.
